blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Three drug suspects were arrested in separate buy-bust operations here that resulted in the confiscation of a combined 7.85 grams of suspected shabu valued at P53,380, police said. The first operation was conducted at about 7 p.m. on Friday in Purok 6, Barangay Saray, resulting in the arrest of alias “Opaw,” 39, a resident of Barangay Gimangpang, Initao, Misamis Oriental. Police seized seven small sachets of suspected shabu from him, valued at P5,508.
